title: Implement FT-002 authority schema and canonical Farm bootstrap
verify: The existing Foundation DatabaseHandle, Access & Admin metadata, and Alembic command path are extended rather than replaced.
PostgreSQL migration evidence proves exact native-UUID tables, checks, indexes, restrictive FKs, JSON audit shape, and the final FarmMembership Farm FK.
Zero and one legacy Farm-ID migration paths preserve valid data; multiple distinct IDs fail before committed mutation; guarded downgrade does not destroy authority data.
Canonical bootstrap creates or reuses local_farm and tomato_001 exactly as specified, preserves existing/archived state, writes only applicable audits, and is a no-op on repeat.
Injected migration/bootstrap/audit failures leave no partial authority state or misleading audit and expose no credentials or raw DB errors.
FT-002-BHV-001 is covered by executable evidence.
evidence_required: canonical bootstrap first-run, partial-run, repeated-run, archived-preservation, and conflict evidence
constraints: Use the verified Foundation DB/session/Alembic path and existing Access & Admin metadata; do not create parallel infrastructure.
Do not rewrite, merge, select, or delete conflicting legacy Farm identities.
Do not create Accounts, first-Boss CLI behavior, admin UI, retained-history services, or downstream operational records.
Do not claim PostgreSQL behavior from SQLite-only evidence.
invariants: PostgreSQL/read model is mutable Farm/Plant/grant/audit authority.
Exactly one local_farm key is possible and authority relationships never cascade delete.
farm_key and plant_key are immutable; bootstrap never overwrites existing display or lifecycle state.
Secrets, auth material, and credential-bearing DB URLs never enter diagnostics or evidence.
verification_targets: Inspect the migrated PostgreSQL schema and prove the exact FarmMembership FK and non-cascading authority relations.
Prove repeated bootstrap changes no ID, display name, status, timestamp, grant, or audit count.
purpose: Establish the exact persisted Farm/Plant/access/audit authority and canonical local seed before lifecycle or HTTP behavior is enabled.
success_outcome: The FT-002 schema is safely migrated, the deferred Farm FK is closed, and local_farm plus tomato_001 can be bootstrapped idempotently without data loss or secret leakage.
anti_goals: No generic ACL or multi-Farm abstraction.

stop_conditions: TASK-011-T3-FT-001-W3 is not done or verified FT-001 schema assumptions no longer hold.
More than one legacy Farm identity requires a product/data decision.
Migration or bootstrap cannot preserve authority data transactionally.
A PostgreSQL-specific claim cannot be evidenced on PostgreSQL.
Diagnostics or evidence contain unredacted secrets or auth material.
